subject: MAP playbook & pilot goals — ClearLake kickoff
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@clearlakehealth.io>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearlakehealth.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: MAP playbook & pilot goals — ClearLake kickoff

Hi Aisha / Tom —

Great to meet you both over email. Per our conversation last week I wanted to kick off the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the ClearLake pilot and put a concrete, 8-week proposal on the table so we can align on success criteria and owners.

High-level pilot goals (proposed):
- Validate latency and throughput at representative workloads (up to 10k daily requests).
- Measure model quality on our internal evaluation set (precision at N, hallucination rate).
- Confirm integration & tokens cost profile with Redwood runtime + caching.
- Verify PHI handling & audit logging for the regulated flows.

Proposed eight-week timeline (high level):
1) Week 0 (this week): MAP sign-off, kickoff, access & onboarding artifacts shared.
2) Week 1–2: Integration + basic smoke tests (embedding & generation paths).
3) Week 3–4: Load testing & cost tuning (batching, cache config).
4) Week 5–6: Eval runs, prompt regression checks, quality sign-off.
5) Week 7–8: Final report, SLA/rollout recommendations, procurement close (if applicable).

Please confirm:
- Are the goals above aligned with ClearLake’s evaluation priorities?
- Who will be the technical owner(s) and procurement contact on your side?
- Does an in-person kickoff fit your calendar? I can propose a 30–45m call.

I’ve attached: MAP-template-ClearLake-v1.xlsx (MAP draft) and pilot-eval-criteria.md (proposed evaluation metrics). If Dec 22 or 23 works, I can send a calendar invite — I tentatively propose Dec 22 at 10:00 AM PT.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: MAP-template-ClearLake-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), pilot-eval-criteria.md (markdown)

Subject: Re: MAP playbook & pilot goals — ClearLake kickoff

Thanks Irene — this looks like a great starting point. I’ll be the executive champion for the pilot and Tom will own technical integration. Procurement is on copy to follow the contractual/PO side.

A couple of notes from our side:
- We absolutely need PHI handling and the audit log window documented in the MAP (regulatory requirement). Can we add an explicit task for SOC2 evidence / retention policy in Week 1?
- Can we shift the kickoff to Dec 22 at 11:00 AM PT instead of 10:00 (we have a standing leadership review at 10).
- We’ll populate the MAP spreadsheet with stakeholder names by EOD Monday.

On the metrics: please add a short section for "regression thresholds" (acceptable percent change vs baseline) — I’ll share our baseline numbers with Tom later today.

On Dec 22 we’ll join via the Zoom link Tom will share. Looking forward to a productive pilot.
